gaps.sentence: We've decided to do ___ a holiday this year.
gaps.explanation: do without = manage without having something.

gaps.sentence: I can't make ___ what the sign says from here.
gaps.explanation: make out = see, hear or understand with difficulty.

gaps.sentence: Come on, join ___ — it's easy once you start.
gaps.explanation: join in = take part in an activity others are doing.

gaps.sentence: When the alarm sounded, everyone made ___ the nearest exit.
gaps.explanation: 'Make for' = move towards, usually in haste.

gaps.sentence: I can't put up ___ this noise any longer.
After twenty years of smoking, he finally managed to give it ___.
gaps.explanation: give up = stop/quit (a habit or attempt).

gaps.sentence: Many consumers now opt ___ cheaper brands.
They want to try ___ the new software before buying.
gaps.explanation: try out = test something to see if it works.
